verdict.rationale: Framer is a hosted website builder and CMS, so letting customers pick a data region or residency is a fair question for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions storage regions, data residency or location controls. The locale auto-redirect in framer-docs-48 is a visitor-language feature, not data residency, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
